question: Which of the five has been most explicit about serving mass-affluent clients, and what exactly have they said?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones states it is targeting high net worth clients as a new initiative, not mass-affluent clients specifically.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models

items.text: Edward Jones states its strategic ambition is to improve the financial wellness for tens of millions of long-term investors across North America, which is broader than just mass-affluent.
items.quote: In accordance with the Partnership's strategic ambition to improve the financial wellness for tens of millions of long-term investors across North America

cells.reason: The passages describe Edward Jones's most recent client-targeting statements, which focus on high net worth clients and broad long-term investors rather than specifically mass-affluent clients.
